mainmenu.title: Main menu
mainmenu.help: Usage: !freefrag [PURPLE][Shortcut] [option][NORMAL] With no shortcuts, this command brings up the main menu.  Available shortcuts: [PURPLE]prac[NORMAL] [1-{0}]: Start practicing on a selected route. [PURPLE]map[NORMAL] [map name]: Switch to another map. [PURPLE]df[NORMAL] [1-6]: Set the difficulty. [PURPLE]mode[NORMAL] [rand/full]: Set training mode. [PURPLE]bw[NORMAL] [rand/ump/ak/sct/awp/pistol/eco/force]: Set weapons for bots. [PURPLE]gun[NORMAL] [ak/m4/m4a1s/awp/deagle/usp/glock/none]: Set your weapon. [PURPLE]jitter[NORMAL] [0-64]: Set bot spawn offset. [PURPLE]repeat[NORMAL] [n/inf/off]: Repeat the current route. [PURPLE]autoskip[NORMAL] [n/off]: Skip route after deaths. [PURPLE]hs[NORMAL] [on/off]: Headshot-only damage. [PURPLE]xray[NORMAL] [on/off]: Outline bots through walls. [PURPLE]botsfire[NORMAL] [on/off]: Bots shoot back. [PURPLE]bothealth[NORMAL] [1-1000]: Set bot health. [PURPLE]botarmor[NORMAL] [0-100]: Set bot armor. [PURPLE]countdown[NORMAL] [0-5]: Seconds the start is held (0 = off). [PURPLE]comp[NORMAL] [on/off]: Lock the settings above so times are comparable. [PURPLE]lang[NORMAL] [en/pt/zh]: Set language. en for English, pt para português, 中文选择 zh。 [PURPLE]record[NORMAL] [save/clear]: Record your path as the guiding line for the current route. [PURPLE]addbot[NORMAL] [crouch/stand/swing/peek/undo/save/clear]: Place a bot where you stand, facing where you look, and save it into the route. [PURPLE]newroute[NORMAL] [name] [bots]: Create an empty route starting where you stand. [PURPLE]top[NORMAL] [1-{0}] [comp]: Show the top 5 runs for a route. [PURPLE]stats[NORMAL]: Show your best times on this map. [PURPLE]binds[NORMAL]: Show the console line that binds arrow keys, Enter and Backspace to the menu. [PURPLE]exit[NORMAL]: Stop practicing.
mainmenu.shortcut_prompt: Type [PURPLE]!freefrag help[NORMAL] for usage of shortcut commands.
menu.footer: Arrows: move   Enter: select   Backspace: back / close

menu.binds_hint: This menu is driven by arrow keys, Enter and Backspace. One-time setup: paste the next line into your console (or type !freefrag binds later).
